headline: Stealth's ox-alpha hits 32.3% — biggest single-model share ever
summary: stealth/ox-alpha just claimed an all-time token-share record at 32.3%, jumping 17.9 percentage points in a single day and cementing stealth as the dominant provider. The surge reshuffled the entire top tier: Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5 dropped to rank 2 despite holding 10.0%, while DeepSeek's v4-flash variants tumbled, and NVIDIA's free Nemotron models climbed steadily. Market concentration (HHI) spiked 6.2 points in 30 days, signaling a winner-take-most dynamic.
highlights: stealth/ox-alpha: 32.3% token share, all-time record (day 1 of streak)
stealth provider: 32.3% share, +17.9% in one day
Xiaomi mimo-v2.5: rank 2 at 10.0%, up 6 spots week-over-week
DeepSeek: 17.8% provider share, -4.3% overnight but +1.6% month-to-date
NVIDIA: 6.6% share, +0.2% daily, +1.8% monthly — steady climber
Anthropic: 2.9% share, -1.6% daily, -6.7% monthly — steep slide
New entrants: Qwen's qwen3.7-flash (rank 50) and OpenAI's gpt-oss-20b (rank 51)
Dropouts: Anthropic's claude-4.7-opus and Qwen's qwen3.8-27b
